name: altis
description: Search and read Altis research — company reports, landscapes, scans, pulses and expert calls — from ChatGPT. Sign in with your Altis account.

interface.longDescription: Search and read Altis research — company reports, market landscapes, scans, pulses, signals and expert-call transcripts — exactly as published on altis.vc. Answers cite the Altis pieces they come from, with links. Read-only. Sign in with your Altis account when you connect: any account can search what Altis covers and has published, and an all-access account reads the research itself.
defaultPrompt: Brief me on Mercor in 300 words using Altis research.
What has Altis published on nuclear fission since September?
Open the Altis report on Harvey and summarise the competitive section.
